service.description: Run the service entry point in the foreground, with the same permissions as the compiled service.

compile.description: Build dist/roon-streamer.exe, the single-file service executable. Don't add --bundle: bundling renames the service constructors, and node-roon-api looks services up by constructor name, so pairing then crashes.

package.description: Build dist/RoonStreamer.zip for installing as a Windows service.
